verified_facts.text: The hotel is set in the building of the Louvre Post Office.
verified_facts.excerpt: nestled in the iconic building of the Louvre Post Office

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the 1st arrondissement, a stone's throw from the Louvre and the Palais Royal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideally located in the historic center of Paris, a stone’s throw from the Louvre and the Palais Royal

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the Louvre Museum, the Bourse de Commerce and the Samaritaine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Paris, a stone’s throw from the Louvre Museum, the Bourse de Commerce and the Samaritaine

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites offer panoramic views over Paris, including the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering panoramic views over the whole city of Paris, including the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre

verified_facts.text: Most rooms and suites have terraces or balconies with views of Parisian rooftops and monuments.
verified_facts.excerpt: the majority of which feature terraces or balconies offering spectacular views of Parisian rooftops and iconic monuments

verified_facts.text: Rooms are dressed in walnut woodwork, warm velvet and bespoke zelliges, in a setting inspired by Art Nouveau.
verified_facts.excerpt: dressed in walnut woodwork, warm velvet and bespoke zelliges. Ultimate comfort is combined with refined design, in a setting inspired by Art Nouveau

verified_facts.text: The 130-square-metre Penthouse is designed like a Parisian apartment suspended above the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 130m² Penthouse, designed like a Parisian apartment suspended above the city

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse looks out on the Centre Pompidou on one side and the Saint-Eustache Church on the other.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Centre Pompidou on one side, and the Saint-Eustache Church on the other

verified_facts.text: Garden View rooms and suites have an outdoor space overlooking the suspended garden, with a shaded terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spacious rooms and suites offer an outdoor space overlooking the suspended garden

verified_facts.text: Eiffel Tower view rooms and suites let guests wake up facing the Eiffel Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Eiffel Tower view rooms and suites offer an exceptional opportunity to wake up facing the most emblematic monument of the City of Light

verified_facts.text: The ROOF rooftop covers 1,000 square metres among cherry trees and lush vegetation.
verified_facts.excerpt: the ROOF rooftop covers 1,000 m². Nestled between cherry trees and lush vegetation

verified_facts.text: The rooftop is reserved for hotel guests during the day and opens to all in the evening for cocktails.

verified_facts.text: The 150-square-metre wellness area has two treatment cabins, a sauna with views over Paris and a fitness room.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exclusive 150 m² wellness area featuring two treatment cabins, a sauna with views over Paris and a fitness room

verified_facts.text: La Plume is a panoramic rooftop restaurant with a tree-lined terrace and views of Saint-Eustache church and the Eiffel Tower.
